assessment: No tutors. In v3.0.0 no maindeck card searches the library for a nonland card. The four that read "search your library" are Arid Mesa, Flooded Strand, Polluted Delta and Scalding Tarn, which fetch lands and belong to the mana analysis. Brallin's partner trigger puts Shabraz into hand from a library, but Brallin is a commander, not a maindeck card, and Shabraz starts in the command zone. This deck finds its pieces by drawing, and every draw is a counter on Shabraz, so redundancy does the tutor's job: four double-strike pieces (Fireshrieker, Lizard Blades, Blade Historian, Akroma's Will), eight protection pieces in the goldfish's group (one drawn by turn 6 in 86.9% of games), and ten wheel cards in its wheel group (86.2% by turn 6). Lae'zel is the thin one: a single card, in 7.1% of opening sevens and drawn by turn 6 in 22.2% of games, and nothing in the 99 can find her.
gaps: N/A: no maindeck library-search tutor in v3.0.0 (validate-tutor-guide's deck_tutors returns none).
The conversion stage (Teferi's Ageless Insight, Bard, King of Dale, Lae'zel, Consecrated Sphinx, Shang-Chi) has no tutor and no passing stack with a draw doubler in it (engine open_questions[1]).
